interface.basis: The 26 MP X-Trans CMOS 4 of the X-M5. UNVERIFIED: both gates are carried over from the X100VI (X-Trans CMOS 5 HR) model that the X-M5 1.30 boot ran with, not measured on this sensor; the X-T3 record of the same sensor family on the XP4 interface gates reads on register 0x51 bit 3 instead. Its fast readout is not decoded.
